mapper.select: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.UserAlarmMapper.list */ SELECT UA.USER_ID AS userId , UA.SHOW_ID AS showId , UA.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate , S.TITLE AS title , S.PLACE AS place , S.OPEN_DATE AS openDate , S.POSTER_LINK AS posterLink FROM USER_ALARM UA LEFT JOIN SHOWS S ON UA.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND UA.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY UA.INSERT_DATE DESC
